props.title: True Ventures backs founders early, when most people aren’t ready to
props.intro: We invest at the very beginning — often before there is a product, a pitch deck or a market anyone else can see. Then we stay, for as long as the company needs us.

props.heading: Founders who pick up when you call.
props.body: A True investment comes with a community of founders who have been exactly where you are. Ask a question about hiring, pricing or a hard board meeting and you will hear back from people who have lived it — usually the same week.

props.caption: An illustrative map of our seven focus areas. Each line stands for one founder connecting with another.

props.heading: Before it’s a market
props.body: Many of the companies we are proudest of looked small or strange on the day we invested. A few of them, by the year we first backed them:

props.heading: How we work
props.body:
In at the start. We prefer to be the first institutional investor, when the company is still a few people and a conviction.

Built by founders. Our partners have built and run companies. We give direct advice and do the unglamorous work alongside you.

We win together. The whole firm works with every company, so you never depend on a single relationship.

Here for the long run. We plan to be in your corner for a decade or more, through good years and hard ones.
